responsibility: Builds and registers the synthetic "by-move" MIR body used when a coroutine-closure is invoked through `FnOnce`/`AsyncFnOnce`, by analyzing parent/child capture relationships, remapping coroutine upvar fields and projections from borrowed captures to owned captures, updating the coroutine self type, and creating a companion synthetic coroutine body definition that is optimized alongside the original by-ref body.
